name: minicrm
description: Malé výukové CRM pro praktické školení práce s vývojovým agentem.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @minicrm/shared && npm run build --workspace @minicrm/api && npm run build --workspace @minicrm/web
scripts.test: npm run test:tui && npm run build --workspace @minicrm/shared && npm run test --workspace @minicrm/shared && npm run test --workspace @minicrm/api && npm run test --workspace @minicrm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @minicrm/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @minicrm/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @minicrm/web
